tests.name: s1-arrival
tests.prompt: Close-up of a pale pistachio-green NIO Firefly compact electric hatchback driving toward the camera on a wet highway at night. The front number plate is a glossy black dealer plate with a thin silver rim; it reads "FIREFLY" in wide-spaced white capitals ending in a chevron mark, with a very small faint line underneath. Crisp, legible, correct lettering that keeps the same size, angle and font through the shot. The car and camera move exactly as before; natural night light.

tests.name: s4-taillights
tests.prompt: Close-up of the rear of a pale pistachio-green NIO Firefly compact electric hatchback pulling away on a wet highway at night, red ring taillights glowing. The rear number plate is a glossy black dealer plate with a thin silver rim in the recess under two small white plate lamps; it reads "FIREFLY" in wide-spaced white capitals ending in a chevron mark, with a very small faint line underneath. Crisp, legible, correct lettering that keeps the same size, angle and font through the shot. The car and camera move exactly as before; natural night light.
